title: feat: Added support for container-type: anchored and @container anchored()
author: lubomirblazekcz
summary: Parses `container-type: anchored` (now as bitflags) and `@container anchored(fallback: ...)` with typed values reusing the position-try-fallbacks types. Released 1.33.0 errors on this syntax, which breaks `vite build` for users of anchored container queries; heavy demand, and the author says both maintainer review points are addressed.
evidence: devongovett review 2026-05-17: use bitflags for ContainerType; parse the feature value with the `position-try-fallbacks` types instead of storing tokens. Author 2026-05-18/08-04 says both are addressed (f82ef9a, adc908c); threads still unresolved but outdated. #1176 has 21 reactions, PR 11; several 'please merge' pings (2026-06 to 2026-10); a user reports 1.33.0 fails with `Unexpected token Function("anchored")`. Calibration (#1176): research spec status and other engines first, early draft goes behind a flag, verify errorRecovery passes it through; the AST change is fine.
